verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own Upscale tool that adds resolution to any image or video (pika-docs-23), which covers the finishing half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a dedicated fast, cheaper draft or preview mode, or a draft-then-upscale workflow. Credit-based pricing and a choice of many models do not establish a lower-cost draft tier. Missing for 10: a documented cheap/fast draft mode, evidence that drafts cost fewer credits, a documented draft-to-final upscale workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of upscale quality.
